paragraphs: We are a Fortune 100 corporation and a leading global distributor and solutions aggregator for the information technology ("IT") ecosystem. We serve a critical role, bringing products from the world's leading and emerging technology vendors to market, and helping our customers create solutions best suited to maximize business outcomes for their end-user customers. We aggregate and distribute IT hardware, software, and systems including personal computing devices and peripherals, mobile phones and accessories, printers, server and datacenter infrastructure, hybrid cloud, security, networking, communications and storage solutions, and system components. We also design and deliver purpose-built server, storage and networking solutions for the hyperscale computing infrastructure market. We operate in three reportable segments based on our geographic regions: the Americas, Europe and Asia-Pacific and Japan ("APJ").

We have been in business since 1980 and have headquarters in both Clearwater, Florida and Fremont, California. We were originally incorporated in the State of California as COMPAC Microelectronics, Inc. in November 1980, and we changed our name to SYNNEX Information Technologies, Inc. in February 1994. We later reincorporated in the State of Delaware under the name of SYNNEX Corporation in October 2003. On September 1, 2021, SYNNEX Corporation acquired Tech Data Corporation, a Florida corporation ("Tech Data") through a series of mergers, which resulted in Tech Data becoming an indirect subsidiary of TD SYNNEX Corporation (collectively, the "Merger"). On October 22, 2021, as a result of the Merger we filed with the Secretary of State of the State of Delaware a Certificate of Amendment to the Company's Restated Certificate of Incorporation to change our corporate name from SYNNEX Corporation to TD SYNNEX Corporation, effective November 3, 2021.

Digital transformation and the migration to cloud computing is reshaping our industry, enabling businesses and consumers to evaluate, procure, acquire, and consume technology products and services in a variety of ways. Hybrid models of IT consumption, supporting both physical and virtual delivery methods are emerging, as hardware and software-based solutions become increasingly combined. As a result, customers are seeking greater integration of products, services and solutions that tie technologies together. Therefore, we believe it is important to provide a broad, end-to-end portfolio, with deep capabilities across the computing continuum to help customers manage the increasingly complex IT ecosystem and deliver the solutions and business outcomes the market desires. Our vision for the future is to be the vital solutions aggregator and orchestrator that connects the IT ecosystem.
We are focusing on the following strategic imperatives in pursuit of our vision:
•Unify our reach by expanding our portfolio in both mature and developing markets through our targeted go-to-market strategy.

•Target new customers by leveraging our specialist go-to-market and trusted advisor approach to deliver tailored value propositions and personalized solutions that align closely with the unique business needs and priorities of each customer.
•Expand our addressable market through our unique vendor value proposition, capitalizing on end-to-end capabilities to support business currently operated by vendors.

•Diversify our offerings within our end-to-end portfolio of products, services and solutions, including providing design, manufacturing and supply chain services to hyperscale computing infrastructure customers.

•Expand and attach our services capabilities to meet our customers' evolving needs, also enabling us to engage earlier in the customer lifecycle, support more complex deployments, drive renewals and deepen our relationships with our customers.

We offer a comprehensive catalog of more than 200,000 technology products (as measured by active SKU's) from approximately 2,500 OEMs, including personal computing devices, mobile phones and accessories, and strategic technologies such as cloud, security, data analytics, AI and hyperscale computing infrastructure. This enables us to offer comprehensive solutions to our reseller and retail customers. We group the majority of our offerings into two primary solutions portfolios, Endpoint Solutions and Advanced Solutions which are comprised of the following:
•Our Endpoint Solutions portfolio primarily includes personal computing devices and peripherals, mobile phones and accessories, printers and supplies.

•Our Advanced Solutions portfolio primarily includes data center technologies such as hybrid cloud, security, storage, networking, servers, software, converged and hyper-converged infrastructure and hyperscale computing infrastructure, via our Hyve business.

Our suppliers include leading IT systems, system components and peripherals, software, communications and security equipment, and networking equipment manufacturers. We purchase these and other complementary products from our suppliers and sell them to our reseller and retail customers. We perform a similar function for our distribution of licensed software products. We provide our vendors with access to large and highly fragmented markets such as small- and medium-sized businesses ("SMB") and serve as a variable, cost effective route to market for our vendors by providing them with access to resellers and end-users.

headings: Risks Related to Our Business and Operations
We anticipate that our revenue and operating results will fluctuate, which could adversely affect the enterprise value of our Company and our securities.
Our gross margins are low, which magnifies the impact of variations in gross margin, operating costs and our operating results.
We experience customer concentration and intense competition which could adversely impact our revenue.

We have pursued and intend to continue to pursue strategic acquisitions or investments in new markets and may encounter risks associated with these activities, which could harm our business and operating results.
Our goodwill and identifiable intangible assets could become impaired, which could have a material non-cash adverse effect on our results of operations.

Because of the capital-intensive nature of our business, we need continued access to capital, which if not available to us or if not available on favorable terms, could harm our ability to operate or expand our business.
We have significant credit exposure to our customers, and negative trends in their businesses could cause us significant credit loss and negatively impact our cash flow and liquidity position.
We are dependent on a variety of IT and telecommunications systems and the Internet, and any failure of these systems could adversely impact our business and operating results.
Issues related to the development and use of AI could give rise to legal and/or regulatory action, damage our reputation or otherwise materially harm our business.
We may experience theft of product from our warehouses, water damage to our properties and other casualty events which could harm our operating results.
We have significant operations globally and any disruption in the operations of our facilities could harm our business and operating results.
We may not be able to generate sufficient cash to service all of our indebtedness and may be forced to take other actions to satisfy our obligations, which could adversely affect our business.
Despite our current level of indebtedness, we and our subsidiaries may still be able to incur substantially more debt. This could further exacerbate the risks to our financial condition.
Changes in our credit rating may increase our interest expense or other costs of capital.
Our variable rate indebtedness subjects us to interest rate risk, which could cause our indebtedness service obligations to increase significantly.
Volatility in the IT industry could have a material adverse effect on our business and operating results.
We are subject to intense competition, both in the United States and internationally, and if we fail to compete successfully, we will be unable to gain or retain market share.

Our business may be adversely affected by some OEM suppliers' strategies to consolidate business or increase their direct sales, which in turn could cause our business and operating results to suffer.
Risks Related to the Macro-Economic and Regulatory Environment
Changes in foreign currency exchange rates and limitations on the convertibility of foreign currencies could adversely affect our business and operating results.
We rely on independent shipping companies for delivery of products, and price increases or service interruptions from these carriers could adversely affect our business and operating results.
We may have higher than anticipated tax liabilities.
Cyberattacks or the improper disclosure or control of confidential information could result in liability and harm our reputation, which could adversely affect our business.
Global health and economic, political and social conditions may harm our ability to do business, increase our costs and negatively affect our stock price.

We are a Fortune 100 corporation and a leading global distributor and solutions aggregator for the information technology ("IT") ecosystem. We serve a critical role, bringing products from the world's leading and emerging technology vendors to market, and helping our customers create solutions best suited to maximize business outcomes for their end-user customers.

We are highly dependent on the end-market demand for IT products, and on our partners' strategic initiatives and business models. This end-market demand is influenced by many factors including the introduction of new IT products and software by OEM suppliers, replacement cycles for existing IT products, trends toward cloud computing, overall economic growth and general business activity. A difficult and challenging economic environment due to the continued persistence of inflation, elevated interest rates, market volatility and adverse effects on product demand connected to geopolitical developments including tariff uncertainty, or other factors may also lead to decline in the IT industry or increased price-based competition. Our systems design and integration solutions business is highly dependent on the demand for cloud infrastructure, and the number of key customers and suppliers in the market. Our business includes operations in the Americas, Europe and Asia-Pacific and Japan ("APJ"), so we are affected by demand for our products in those regions, as well as the impact of fluctuations in foreign currency exchange rates compared to the U.S. dollar.

We continually seek to augment organic growth in our business with strategic acquisitions of businesses and assets that complement and expand our existing capabilities. We also divest businesses that we deem no longer strategic to our ongoing operations. We seek to acquire new OEM relationships, enhance our supply chain and integration capabilities, the services we provide to our customers and OEM suppliers, and expand our geographic footprint.

On July 1, 2025, we completed the acquisition of Apptium Technologies, LLC and its subsidiaries ("Apptium"), a software development company and provider of a cloud commerce platform that represents a critical investment in our technology solutions orchestration strategy. We acquired all of the outstanding shares of Apptium for a purchase price of approximately $105.1 million.

In addition to disclosing financial results that are determined in accordance with GAAP, we also disclose certain non-GAAP financial information, including:

•Revenue in constant currency, which is revenue adjusted for the translation effect of foreign currencies so that certain financial results can be viewed without the impact of fluctuations in foreign currency exchange rates, thereby facilitating period-to-period comparisons of our business performance. Revenue in constant currency is calculated by translating the revenue for the fiscal year ended November 30, 2025 in the billing currency using the comparable prior period currency conversion rate. Generally, when the dollar either strengthens or weakens against other currencies, the growth at constant currency rates will be higher or lower than growth reported at actual exchange rates.

•Adjusted selling, general and administrative expenses, which excludes the amortization of intangible assets and share-based compensation expense. TD SYNNEX also uses adjusted selling, general and administrative expenses as a percentage of gross profit, which is a useful metric in considering the portion of gross profit retained after selling, general and administrative expenses.

paragraphs: 本公司為《財富》百大企業，為資訊科技（"IT"）生態系的領導性全球經銷商與解決方案整合商。我們在市場中扮演關鍵角色，將全球知名與新興科技供應商的產品帶入市場，並協助客戶建立最適合其終端客戶以達成最佳商業成果的解決方案。我們整合與經銷IT硬體、軟體與系統，包括個人計算設備與周邊裝置、行動電話與配件、印表機、伺服器與資料中心基礎設施、混合雲端、安全性、網路、通訊與儲存解決方案，以及系統零組件。我們也設計與提供專為超規模計算基礎設施市場所打造的伺服器、儲存與網路解決方案。我們根據地理區域分為三個應報告分部：美洲、歐洲與亞太及日本（"APJ"）。

本公司自1980年起營運，總部設於佛羅裏達州克里爾沃特與加州弗裏蒙特。本公司最初於1980年11月在加州註冊為COMPAC Microelectronics, Inc.，並於1994年2月更名為SYNNEX Information Technologies, Inc.。之後於2003年10月在特拉華州重新註冊為SYNNEX Corporation。2021年9月1日，SYNNEX Corporation透過一系列合併取得佛羅裏達州公司Tech Data Corporation（"Tech Data"），此合併使Tech Data成為TD SYNNEX Corporation的間接子公司（ collectively, the "Merger"）。2021年10月22日，因應此合併，本公司向特拉華州州務卿提交《公司章程修正案》以將本公司名稱由SYNNEX Corporation更名為TD SYNNEX Corporation，自2021年11月3日起生效。

數位轉型與向雲端計算遷移正在重塑我們的產業，使企業與消費者能以多種方式評估、採購、取得與使用科技產品與服務。混合型IT使用模式正在興起，支援實體與虛擬交付方式，隨著硬體與軟體解決方案逐漸結合，客戶正尋求更高度整合的產品、服務與解決方案，以串聯各項科技。因此，我們認為提供廣泛、端到端的產品組合，並在計算連續體中具備深厚能力，是協助客戶管理日益複雜的IT生態系並交付市場所渴求的解決方案與商業成果的重要因素。我們對未來的願景是成為連接IT生態系的關鍵解決方案整合商與協調者。
為實現我們的願景，我們正著重於以下戰略重點：
•透過我們的目標導向市場進入策略，擴展我們在成熟與發展中市場的產品組合，以統一我們的影響力。
•透過我們的專門市場進入與值得信賴的顧問方法，針對新客戶提供量身打造的價值主張與個性化解決方案，以緊密符合每位客戶獨特的商業需求與優先事項。
•透過我們獨特的供應商價值主張，擴展我們可接觸的市場，並利用端到端能力支援目前由供應商運作的業務。
•在我們端到端的產品、服務與解決方案組閤中，多元化我們的提供內容，包括為超規模計算基礎設施客戶提供設計、製造與供應鏈服務。
•擴展並附加我們的服務能力，以符合客戶不斷變化的需求，同時也使我們能更早參與客戶的生命週期，支持更複雜的部署，推動續約並深化與客戶的關係。

我們提供一個涵蓋超過200,000項科技產品（以活躍SKU數量計算）的完整產品目錄，來自約2,500家OEM，包括個人計算設備、行動電話及配件，以及策略性科技如雲端、安全、資料分析、AI及超規模計算基礎設施。這使我們能為經銷商及零售客戶提供完整的解決方案。我們將絕大多數產品分為兩個主要解決方案組合，即端點解決方案（Endpoint Solutions）及先進解決方案（Advanced Solutions），其組成如下：
•我們的端點解決方案（Endpoint Solutions）組合主要包含個人計算設備及週邊裝置、行動電話及配件、印表機及耗材。
•我們的先進解決方案（Advanced Solutions）組合主要包含資料中心科技，如混合雲端、安全、儲存、網路、伺服器、軟體、收斂及超收斂基礎設施和超規模計算基礎設施，透過我們的Hyve業務提供。
我們的供應商包括領導的IT系統、系統零組件及週邊裝置、軟體、通訊及安全設備，以及網路設備製造商。我們從供應商處購入這些及其他補充性產品，並銷售給我們的經銷商及零售客戶。我們對於經銷我們授權軟體產品的分銷也執行類似的功能。我們為供應商提供存取大型且高度分散的市場，例如中小型企業（"SMB"），並透過提供存取經銷商及最終用戶，成為供應商變動且成本效益高的市場通路。

我們是《財富》100 大企業，並為資訊科技（"IT"）生態系的領導全球經銷商與解決方案整合者。我們在市場中扮演關鍵角色，將世界各主要及新興科技供應商的產品引入市場，並協助客戶創造最適合其終端客戶的解決方案。

我們高度依賴 IT 產品的終端市場需求，以及我們合作夥伴的戰略計畫與商業模式。此終端市場需求受許多因素影響，包括 OEM 供應商推出的新 IT 產品與軟體、現有 IT 產品的更換週期、朝向雲端計算的趨勢、總體經濟成長與整體商業活動。因持續存在的通貨膨脹、高利率、市場波動及與地緣政治發展相關的產品需求影響，例如關稅不確定性或其他因素，可能導致 IT 行業衰退或增加以價格為基礎的競爭。我們的系統設計與整合解決方案業務高度依賴雲端基礎設施的需求，以及市場中關鍵客戶與供應商的數量。我們的業務包含美洲、歐洲與亞太及日本（"APJ"）地區的運作，因此我們受這些地區對我們產品需求的影響，以及與美元相比外幣交換率波動的影響。
我們持續尋求透過戰略收購與資產，以補強我們業務的內生成長。我們也出售我們認為不再符合我們持續運作戰略的業務。我們尋求建立新的 OEM 關係、強化我們的供應鏈與整合能力、為我們客戶與 OEM 供應商提供的服務，以及擴展我們的地理足跡。
2025 年 7 月 1 日，我們完成了對 Apptium Technologies, LLC 及其子公司（"Apptium"）的收購，Apptium 是一家軟體開發公司與雲端通 commerce 平台供應商，代表我們在科技解決方案整合策略上的關鍵投資。我們以約 1 億 5 千 1 百萬美元的價格收購了 Apptium 所有發行在外的股權。
2021 年 9 月 1 日，SYNNEX Corporation 透過一系列合併方式收購了位於佛羅裏達州的 Tech Data Corporation（"Tech Data"），此後 Tech Data 成為 TD SYNNEX Corporation 的間接子公司（合稱為 "合併"）。

除了揭露依 GAAP 計算之財務結果外，我們亦揭露部分非 GAAP 財務資訊，包括：
•以固定匯率計算之營業收入，為調整外幣匯率影響後之營業收入，使財務結果不受外幣匯率波動影響，從而有助於比較各期間之營運表現。以固定匯率計算之營業收入，係以 2025 年 11 月 30 日為財務年度終結之營業收入，使用與前一期間相同之外幣兌換率進行換算。通常，當美元對其他貨幣升值或貶值時，以固定匯率計算之成長率將會高於或低於實際匯率計算之成長率。
•調整後之營銷、一般及行政費用，排除無形資產攤銷及員工持股計畫費用。TD SYNNEX 亦使用調整後之營銷、一般及行政費用佔毛利率百分比，此為評估扣除營銷、一般及行政費用後留存毛利率之有用指標。

headings: 與我們業務及運作相關的風險
我們預期本公司營業收入及營運結果將有所波動，這可能會對本公司企業價值及本公司證券產生不利影響。
我們的毛利率偏低，這會放大毛利率、營運成本及營運結果的變動影響。
我們面臨客戶集中及激烈競爭的情況，這可能會對我們的營收產生不利影響。
我們已進行並打算繼續進行戰略收購或投資新市場，可能會遇到與這些活動相關的風險，這可能會損害我們的業務及營運結果。
我們的商譽及可辨認無形資產可能會發生減值，這可能會對我們的營運結果產生重大非現金的不利影響。
由於我們業務的資本密集性，我們需要持續取得資金，若無法取得資金或無法以有利條件取得資金，可能會影響我們運作或擴張業務的能力。
我們對客戶有顯著的信用風險，若其業務出現負面趨勢，可能會導致我們產生重大信用損失，並對我們的現金流及流動性地位產生負面影響。
我們依賴多種資訊科技及電信系統與互聯網，任何這些系統的故障都可能對我們的業務與營運結果造成不利影響。
與人工智慧的開發及使用相關的問題，可能引發法律及/或監管行動，損害我們的聲譽，或以其他方式對我們的業務造成重大傷害。
我們可能遭遇產品遭竊、倉庫財產遭水災損壞及其他意外事件，這些都可能對我們的營運結果造成損害。
我們在全球擁有大量營運據點，任何營運據點的中斷都可能對我們的業務與營運結果造成損害。
與我們負債相關的風險
我們可能無法產生足夠現金以償還所有負債，並可能被迫採取其他行動以履行我們的義務，這可能對我們的業務造成不利影響。
儘管我們目前負債水平較高，我們與我們的子公司仍可能進一步增加大量負債。這可能會進一步加劇對我們財務狀況的風險。
我們信用評級的變動可能提高我們的利息支出或其他資金成本。
我們的浮動利率負債使我們面臨利率風險，這可能會導致我們的負債服務義務顯著增加。
與我們產業相關的風險
資訊科技產業的波動可能會對我們的業務及營運結果產生重大不利影響。
我們面臨來自美國與國際間的激烈競爭，若我們無法成功競爭，將無法獲得或維持市場佔有率。
我們的業務可能因某些OEM供應商的策略，例如整併業務或增加直接銷售，而受到不利影響，這可能會導致我們的業務及營運結果受損。
與總體經濟及監管環境相關的風險
外幣交換率的變動及外幣兌換限制，可能會對我們的業務及營運結果產生不利影響。
我們依賴獨立運輸公司進行產品配送，這些電信業者的價格上漲或服務中斷，可能會對我們的業務及營運結果產生不利影響。
我們可能面臨高於預期的稅務負擔。
網路攻擊或 confidential information 之不當揭露或控制，可能導致我們負擔責任並損害聲譽，進而對我們的業務產生不利影響。
全球健康與經濟、政治及社會條件可能影響我們的營運能力，提高我們的成本，並對我們的股票價格產生負面影響。
paragraphs: 以下討論分為幾個部分。第一部分，即本段落之後立即開始，標題為 "與我們業務及運作相關的風險"，討論了可能影響我們業務、運作結果及財務狀況的一些風險。第二部分，標題為 "與我們負債相關的風險"，討論了我們與負債相關的風險。第三部分，標題為 "與我們產業相關的風險"，討論了影響我們產業中營運企業的風險。第四部分，標題為 "與總體經濟及監管環境相關的風險"，涉及影響我們營運地區內企業的廣泛風險。您應仔細審閱所有這些部分，以及我們的合併財務報表及其附註，以及本報告中出現的其他資訊，以取得有關影響我們的風險的重要資訊。這些風險因素應與評估本報告中包含的前瞻性陳述一同考量，因為這些因素可能會導致實際結果與條件與前瞻性陳述中預測的結果有重大差異。在您投資本公司之前，您應知道，進行此投資涉及一些風險，包括下列所描述的風險。已經在此強調的風險並非我們所面臨的唯一風險。如果任何風險實際發生，可能會對我們的業務、財務狀況及運作結果產生負面影響。在這種情況下，我們的普通股交易價格可能會下跌，您可能會損失全部或部分投資。
我們的營運結果已出現波動，未來也可能出現波動，原因包括：
•我們所進行的業務收購及出售的影響；•總體經濟狀況及資訊科技支出水準；
•我們的重要OEM供應商或客戶的流失或合併；
•我們產品及服務的市場接受度、品質、價格、可取得性及使用壽命，以及所銷售產品及服務的組合；
•我們產業中的競爭狀況；•朝向雲端基礎建設及 "即服務" 類型產品提供的趨勢；
